description: SEO report for one website: estimated Google traffic and keywords, 12-month trend, top 100 keywords, quick wins, competitors, top pages, on-page problems with fix prompts and a plain-language summary. Use when a founder or marketer asks how a site is doing on Google, what it ranks for, who its search competitors are or what to fix next. Data from DataForSEO (estimates, one country per call). Returns strength 0-100, overview {traffic, keywords, trafficValueUsd, positions {top3, top10, top20, top30, top100}, newKeywords, lostKeywords}, history[] by month, topKeywords[] and quickWins[] {keyword, position, volume, difficulty, cpc, intent, url, traffic}, competitors[], topPages[], health {score, problems, items[] with fix prompts}, summary and actions[]. Not charged when the data source fails. Price: $0.50 per call from Exepal credit; not charged if the call fails.

country.description: Two-letter country for Google data: us (default), gb, ca, au, nz, ie, in, sg, ae, za, ph, pk, np, de, fr, es, it, nl, br, mx, jp
